h1: Turnkey Apartment and House Renovation in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Turnkey Apartment and House Renovation in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides comprehensive turnkey renovation services for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces in Bratislava, Vienna, and other cities across Slovakia and Austria.

We can manage the entire project — from interior design, technical documentation, and cost estimation to construction and finishing works, interior furnishing, custom-made furniture production, and final installation.

The scope of work may include demolition, construction of partitions, electrical and plumbing works, wall and ceiling preparation, tile and flooring installation, painting, lighting installation, sanitary equipment installation, doors, built-in furniture, and custom cabinetry.

We pay particular attention to ensuring that the renovation closely follows the approved interior design project. This allows us to define the locations of furniture, lighting, electrical points, and plumbing in advance, select materials beforehand, and reduce the number of changes during construction.
Turnkey Renovation with One Team
Clients can receive a complete range of services from DUMSKAYA DESIGN:

items: technical documentation for the construction team;
furnishing with lighting, sanitary equipment, and appliances;
production of custom kitchens, wardrobes, and other furniture;

parts.html: We can also carry out individual stages of renovation if the interior design project or part of the work has already been completed by another contractor.
Types of Renovation and Construction Works
DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides a full range of construction, engineering, and finishing works for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces.
Depending on the property and selected project format, we can carry out either a complete turnkey renovation or individual stages of work.
Demolition and Preparation Works
Demolition of partitions, flooring, tiles, ceiling structures, doors, sanitary equipment, and other existing interior elements. Preparation of the property for construction and engineering works.
Partition Construction and General Building Works

Construction of new block and plasterboard partitions, niches, boxes, decorative structures, preparation of openings, surface leveling, and other construction works according to the technical documentation.
Electrical Works

Installation of new electrical wiring, relocation and installation of sockets and switches, electrical panels, connections for household appliances, lighting, LED lighting systems, and other electrical equipment.
Plumbing Works

Installation and modification of water supply and drainage systems, relocation of plumbing points, installation of concealed toilet systems, bathtubs, shower systems, washbasins, mixers, kitchen plumbing, and other equipment.
Heating and Engineering Systems

Installation and relocation of radiators, preparation of connections for heating equipment, installation of underfloor heating, and other engineering works according to the technical possibilities of the property.
Plastering and Painting Works
Wall and ceiling leveling, plastering, filling, priming, surface preparation for painting or decorative coatings, and painting of walls and ceilings.
Plasterboard Works
Installation of plasterboard ceilings, partitions, niches, boxes, cornices, concealed lighting structures, and other interior elements.
Tiling Works
Installation of ceramic tiles, porcelain stoneware, mosaics, and large-format materials in bathrooms, kitchens, entrance areas, and other spaces.
Flooring
Preparation of the subfloor and installation of parquet, engineered wood flooring, laminate, SPC, vinyl flooring, tiles, and other types of floor coverings.
Doors and Decorative Elements
Installation of interior and concealed doors, skirting boards, decorative wall panels, mouldings, and other interior elements.
Lighting
Installation of recessed and surface-mounted lights, pendant lighting, track lighting systems, decorative lighting, and LED profiles.
Installation of Sanitary Equipment
Installation of toilets, bathtubs, shower cabins and partitions, mixers, sinks, heated towel rails, mirrors, and other equipment.
Custom-Made Furniture
Design, production, delivery, and installation of kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, TV units, wall panels, bathroom furniture, and other custom cabinetry made to individual dimensions.
Interior Furnishing and Procurement
Selection and ordering of finishing materials, sanitary equipment, lighting, doors, furniture, and other interior elements in accordance with the approved interior design project.
Final Installation and Property Preparation
Installation of furniture, lighting, sanitary equipment, and decorative elements, completion of installation works, and preparation of the interior for use.
Renovation Cost

The cost of renovation is calculated individually and depends on the size and condition of the property, the scope of demolition and construction works, the complexity of engineering solutions, selected materials, furnishing level, and required implementation schedule.

For a preliminary estimate, you can provide us with the floor plan, interior design project, or available technical documentation. After reviewing the initial information, we can prepare an approximate cost estimate, followed by a detailed quotation once the scope of work has been clarified.

For properties without an existing project, we recommend preparing the interior design and technical documentation first. This makes it possible to calculate the renovation budget more accurately before construction begins and reduce the number of additional decisions during implementation.
Complete Interior Project Implementation

With a comprehensive project implementation package, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can manage the property from interior design and technical documentation through renovation, furnishing, and furniture installation.
This approach allows all key stages to be coordinated within one project and helps ensure that the finished interior closely matches the approved visualizations and technical solutions.
